method: Actions = top-level operators in base.tla whose body primes s (96, matching checks/action-map.json). Reads/writes extracted by scanner over s.<path> occurrences, EXCEPT clauses (nested record/function rewrites refined to sub-fields, identity copies dropped) and helper operators (CT, LiveMap, KnownAssignment, HistoryAfterLookup, Outstanding, ClientCanPoll, Remember*, RunnerLockFree, Disconnected, AcceptedIds, HasAggregate) expanded to their field reads; new-attempt creation adds net[t][c][n].* writes. Group/process/mechanism and access classes are manual annotations. Extraction scripts: .tmp/extract_fedavg.py, .tmp/build_partition.py.

worstOracles: WFCommResendTask: ct.result=none /\ ct.delivery=failed (SJ reads CJ execution state and an unobservable network loss; real rule: resend on re-request while result_received_time is None)
ClientCheckTask: SJ step writes the CJ outcome and the queued envelope atomically (TASK_CHECK reply + CJ reaction + upload folded)
ClientLoseDispatchAck: CJ guard on SJ stage in {queued,processing,handled}
ClockAdvance: stops at CTRL wf.pc=finalized and writes COMM ages

actions.name: BaseAcceptTrainResult

actions.name: BaseProcessUnknownResult

actions.name: WFCommResendTask

actions.name: BasePrepareTaskData

actions.name: WFCommPublishClientTask

actions.name: WFCommCancelTask
actions.note: Direct mark-only cancel; driven by an unmodeled caller (admin/app).

actions.name: ClientCheckTask
actions.boundary: TASK_CHECK reply + CJ reaction + RESULT_ENVELOPE send folded
actions.note: Trace node is server. Must be split: SJ AnswerTaskCheck (receipt, LRU touch) / CJ ObserveCheckReply (outcome) / CJ SendEnvelope (stage queued).

actions.name: WFCommClaimSubmission
actions.note: Claim under comm lock, then releases it: claim->dispatch window open to monitor retirement.

actions.name: WFCommReportDeadClient
actions.note: process_dead_client_report from job lifecycle (CP/SP dead-job report).

actions.name: WFCommClientIsActive
actions.note: Job heartbeat / other activity from CJ (JOB_HEART_BEAT aux).

actions.name: WFCommMonitorRemove
actions.note: Retirement: standing=FALSE, ordered history incl. unreceived assignments.

actions.name: ServerRunnerCloseWorkflow
actions.note: current_wf=None under runner wf_lock after control_flow returns.

actions.name: WFCommFinalizeRun
actions.note: Cancels standing tasks, clears retired history, stops monitor.

actions.name: ClientProcessTask
actions.note: Nondeterministic kind/mk = trainer stand-in.

actions.name: ClientLoseDispatchAck
actions.note: Local submit timeout or reply loss; server stage untouched.

FED_CTRL.description: FedAvg/BaseModelController: controller thread (round loop, broadcast call, polls, close, aggregate/update/save, panic) + application result callback body (preliminary accept, conversion, FedAvg consumer with per-round guard, weighted helpers, decision, unknown hook).
mechanismsInside: per-round guard aggr.locked/failed/closed shared by callback and CloseRound
partial per-key helper mutation then failure (#5293 family, MC-4 analogue)
dynamic failed-client context reset at broadcast (TV-1 family)
coarseMustReproduce: one SCHEDULE per round, next round only after anyStanding=FALSE
for every APP_CALL(live): exactly one APP_RETURN before COMM may stamp; decision rejected for rc error, conversion failure, empty params, shape mismatch, failed/closed round
rc error: PANIC unless resilient; dynamic adds failedClients, reset at next broadcast
param/metric failure: round failed with partial helper state retained, rejected, then CANCEL_ALL(ERROR) -> PANIC/outcome error, NO publication
abort observed: close round (later live APP_CALLs rejected) and WORKFLOW_RETURNED(aborted) without publication
zero accepted: PANIC/outcome error, no publication; publication only with >=1 accepted and no failure
APP_CALL(unknown): no aggregation, no count, no decision
CloseRound waits for an in-progress callback (round lock) - a coarse variant may not publish while an APP_CALL is outstanding

FED_COMM.description: WFCommServer + ServerRunner: task table, GET_TASK processing (prepare/protect/publish/filter/try-again/resend), TASK_CHECK answering, submission admission/check/claim/acquire/dispatch/stamp/drop/reject, task monitor, dead-client watch and job policy, mark-only cancellation, workflow close/finalize, retired-assignment history, run-abort latch.
mechanismsInside: comm (_controller_lock) shared by request, submission and monitor
claim releases comm lock before dispatch: monitor retirement in the claim->dispatch window
retired history (LRU) incl. unreceived assignments; first late result -> unknown path once
dead-client watch: clock sample before watch lock, report replacement (serial), per-client policy reads
consumes: env: DEAD_JOB_REPORT(site), CLIENT_ACTIVE(site) heartbeat, direct CANCEL(t), clock
coarseMustReproduce: GET_TASK replies: ASSIGNED (new authority, or resend with SAME authority after a lost/failed delivery), TRY_AGAIN (prepare/snapshot/filter failure, task not LIVE), NO_TASK
TASK_CHECK_REPLY by state: known & unclaimed -> RETRY; claimed -> RECEIVED; evicted/closed/aborted/unknown -> TASK_CLOSED; retired-in-history -> RETRY/RECEIVED by received bit
one RESULT_RECEIPT per processed envelope; RECEIVED for first claim and for duplicates after claim; TASK_CLOSED when closed/aborted/unknown
a queued envelope may be processed after the CJ timed out and started attempt n+1 (stale attempt still claims/acks)

APP_CALL(live) at most once per assignment, only if standing & LIVE at dispatch; APP_CALL(unknown) at most once per assignment for the first claimed result of a retired-in-history or non-LIVE task; no new admission after close/abort (earlier-admitted submissions still claim and dispatch)
retirement between claim and dispatch remains possible: claimed=TRUE with decision pending and no finish timestamp
standing(t) never becomes FALSE while an APP_CALL for t is outstanding
retire with OK (all finished), CLIENT_DEAD (all outstanding disconnected after lead time; any live outstanding blocks), CANCELLED/ERROR (marked), keeping retiredOutstanding
dead-policy PANIC (all dead, < MinSites alive, required site dead) stops the monitor before task checks
finalize: cancel standing, clear history, stop monitor; later submissions TASK_CLOSED

FED_CLIENT.description: ClientRunner fetch/run/send loop for one site: decode assignment, execute (trainer stand-in), task-check/submit retries with transport attempts, receipt handling, local timeout.
mechanismsInside: one result per client task, retained across retries
local timeout independent of server progress
consumes: env: trainer result choice, network loss
coarseMustReproduce: GET_TASK only when idle; re-poll after TRY_AGAIN/NO_TASK/lost assignment (drives resend)
exactly one result per (clientTask, attempt): OK params | OK empty | EXECUTION_EXCEPTION, x metricKind
every transport attempt n starts with TASK_CHECK and carries the same authority correlation
RETRY -> send envelope; RECEIVED -> ack; TASK_CLOSED -> gone
local timeout while awaiting RESULT_RECEIPT (old envelope may still be queued/processing at SJ) then attempt n+1: overlapping attempts must stay possible
no access to SJ state

mechanisms.verdict: inside (not reachable in seed: one standing task)

hardProblems: s.net[t][c][n] is endpoint state + channel in one record (stage=SJ, outcome=CJ, receipt=reply); ClientCheckTask folds SJ answer, CJ consumption and envelope upload into one step, and ServerRunnerTaskRequestActive folds the CJ GET_TASK send. Splitting adds interleavings the 34 traces never exercised and their single 'server' events must be re-mapped.

ct.delivery merges SJ filter stage, network transit and CJ decode; the resend guard reads it plus ct.result as a cooperative-client oracle. Replacing it with the real SJ rule (resend while no finish timestamp) plus a CJ 'poll only when idle' gate must not re-introduce re-execution of a claimed task; needs a refinement check against the seed.

The application callback (23 actions) runs inside COMM's lock frame (comm.kind/pc/key/accepted). The CTRL/COMM cut becomes a blocking APP_CALL/APP_RETURN, and CallbackRoundIsolation plus 'standing=FALSE only after APP_RETURN' are cross-group protocol properties that every coarse COMM/CTRL must preserve.

wf.pc is a handshake for 4 COMM actions (schedule, close, finalize, monitor/clock stop); wf.abort is a 3-writer latch (2 CTRL panics, 1 COMM policy panic) read on both sides and later also driven by NVJobs.

Identity is encoded by index (t=round, (t,c,n) correlation, Authority from index): ports need explicit correlation fields; VSNetworkV1 has no TASK_CHECK/TASK_CHECK_REPLY kinds and no transport-attempt field; VSComposition's BuildSubmission/ReceiveReceipt read fedState.assignments from CJ (oracle).

Existing coarse interface/refinement is monolithic and success-only (1 round, strict, all-required, MetricKinds={none}); per-group coarse variants with failure outcomes and their refinement maps do not exist yet.
